company: SambaNova was founded in 2017 and is led by co-founder and CEO Rodrigo Liang. It designs its own AI chips, known as RDUs, and sells complete systems, on-premises software and SambaCloud, with a focus on running AI models quickly and efficiently.

In July 2026 SambaNova completed a $1 billion first close of its Series F at an $11 billion post-money valuation, led by General Atlantic with BlackRock, T. Rowe Price, Intel Capital, Qatar Investment Authority and Vista. It came months after a $350 million-plus raise with an Intel partnership, and alongside a JPMorganChase deployment.
intelligence.why_it_matters: SambaNova is one of the main private challengers to Nvidia in AI inference, and a read-through for whether specialized chips can win share as inference spending grows.

changed.text: It raises $350M+ alongside a partnership with Intel.

takeaways: Inference, not training, is its focus, and that market is growing fastest.
Blue-chip investors and a major bank customer add credibility.
It competes with Nvidia and several other chip startups.
Chip businesses need heavy ongoing investment.
